column2: Ttitle: Verify that Guest joined to the Group session when Reservation = Reserved

Pre-conditions:
The Owner has generated and shared a valid link
Reservation status is "Reserved"

Steps:
1. Guest redirected by shared link.
2. Investigate "You're invated" pop-up window.
3. Enter 1 character in the "Enter your name" field.
4. Click [Browse menu] button.
column3:
Expected result:
1. "You're invated" pop-up window is opened.
2. "You're invated" pop-up window contains:
who invited, restaurant name, location, date&time. And presented according Figma design: https://www.figma.com/file/h42Bx53fFhcAkTMPHwr0ef?type=design&node-id=110716%3A28383&mode=dev 
"Enter your name" field is empty
[Browse menu] is disabled.
3. [Browse menu] is enabled.
4. Guest is redericted to the Menu page.

column2: Ttitle: Verify that Guest is redirected to the static page with appropriate message when Reservation = Cancelled

Pre-conditions:
The Owner has generated and shared a valid link
Reservation status is "Cancelled"

Steps:
1. Guest redirected by shared link.
column3:
Expected result:
1. Static page with message "This pre-order session has expired or is no longer active." is opened.
